description: This PHP source file defines the CreateTestDatabaseCommand class, which is a Symfony Console command used to create and populate a test database for the OrangeHRM system. It handles database schema creation, dumping, and fixture setup, mainly for testing purposes.

classes.name: CreateTestDatabaseCommand
classes.description: A Symfony Console command class that facilitates the creation and initialization of a test database environment for testing purposes within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command description and options for the CLI command.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the command with input and output interfaces, setting up styled output.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method invoked when running the command; handles dropping and creating the test database, dumping data, and setting up fixtures.

methods.name: createTestDBConnection
methods.description: Creates and returns a Doctrine Connection object configured for the test database.
